text:
violet: Quick sync  launching the inference benchmark + webinar next Wed. Need final X + LinkedIn schedule, assets, and inbound routing to SDRs by EOD Mon. Anyone object to a two-wave approach?

omar: No objections. Proposal: Wave 1 (AM): 2-tweet hook + 1 GIF. Wave 2 (PM): deeper 4-tweet thread with sample chart and CTA to sign-up. LinkedIn longform between waves.

casey: For headline metric we should pick one defensible stat: either "~35% lower cost per response" or "sub-40ms p95". We'll A/B. I need bench snapshot to approve wording.

design: Asset list noted: hero GIF (16:9), static thumbnail (1200x628), accessible alt text, and a LinkedIn cover image. GIF mock Wed AM, final Thu.

omar: Can ops create a dedicated HubSpot form (utm=bench_launch) and shortlink? We want campaign_variant field for A/B.

ops-bot: HubSpot endpoint created: https://hooks.example.com/hubspot/bench-2026. Shortlink: https://go.redwood.ai/bench1 (tracks utm_source=social). Webhook accepts campaign_variant. Test payload: {"email":"test@redwood.com","utm_campaign":"bench_launch","campaign_variant":"A"}

casey: Good. Please add hidden field source=social so we can segment.

omar: Paid plan: $1,200 day-of split 70/30 favoring AM hook. Targeting: eng + infra + PMs. Conversion = form submit.

paid-media: Confirmed. Also testing a $300 LinkedIn boost for the longform with conversion tracking back to the same form.

sdr-bot: SDR routing: real-time Slack ping to #sdr-inbound for each signup + daily CSV at 8:30am. Add top engagement signal (clicked GIF / commented).

casey: Copy snippets (short):
- violet: "35% lower per-response cost on common prompts. See our benchmark + demo: https://go.redwood.ai/bench1"
- violet: "Serve responses faster  sub-40ms p95 in our tests. Join the webinar: https://go.redwood.ai/bench1"

design: Reminder: post native threads (not screenshots). Provide each tweet as a separate line and supply alt text.

casey: I'll QA all metric claims vs the public bench doc before sign-off. No social post until I approve.

ovar: (typo) meant ops-bot.

violet: OK team  finalize by Mon EOD. I'll add a Notion task list and tag owners. :rocket:
